corpus: 941 real Crawl jobs (VietJobs IT + Fake Jobs) in the platform database
ground_truth_source: Rule-based silver labels: retrieval relevance from SQL over skills and titles (relevance_rule), frozen as job ids; SQL answers computed directly in PostgreSQL. No LLM was used for labelling. retrieval_paraphrase reuses the same relevant ids with queries that avoid skill names.

retrieval.query: Kỹ sư AI / Machine Learning làm mô hình deep learning
retrieval.relevance_rule: (exists (select 1 from job_skills js join skills s on s.id=js.skill_id where js.job_id=j.id and (s.canonical_name ilike 'Machine Learning' or s.canonical_name ilike 'Deep Learning' or s.canonical_name ilike 'TensorFlow' or s.canonical_name ilike 'PyTorch' or s.canonical_name ilike '%học máy%' or s.canonical_name ilike 'machine learning concepts%')) or (j.title ilike '%AI %' or j.title ilike '%AI' or j.title ilike 'AI%' or j.title ilike '%machine learning%' or j.title ilike '%ML %' or j.title ilike '%deep learning%' or j.title ilike '%trí tuệ nhân tạo%')) and j.title not ilike '%kinh doanh%' and j.title not ilike '%sales%'

retrieval.query: Lập trình viên Flutter phát triển ứng dụng di động
retrieval.relevance_rule: (exists (select 1 from job_skills js join skills s on s.id=js.skill_id where js.job_id=j.id and (s.canonical_name ilike 'Flutter')) or (j.title ilike '%flutter%'))

(exists (select 1 from job_skills js join skills s on s.id=js.skill_id where js.job_id=j.id and (s.canonical_name ilike 'Go')) or (j.title ilike '%golang%' or j.title ilike '% go %' or j.title ilike 'go %'))

retrieval.query: Data analyst làm báo cáo Power BI
retrieval.relevance_rule: (exists (select 1 from job_skills js join skills s on s.id=js.skill_id where js.job_id=j.id and (s.canonical_name ilike 'Power BI' or s.canonical_name ilike '%Power BI%')) or (j.title ilike '%data analyst%' or j.title ilike '%phân tích dữ liệu%' or j.title ilike '%BI %' or j.title ilike '%BI'))

retrieval.query: Data engineer xây pipeline với Spark và Kafka
retrieval.relevance_rule: (exists (select 1 from job_skills js join skills s on s.id=js.skill_id where js.job_id=j.id and (s.canonical_name ilike 'Apache Spark' or s.canonical_name ilike '%Spark%')) or (j.title ilike '%data engineer%' or j.title ilike '%big data%' or j.title ilike '%kỹ sư dữ liệu%'))

retrieval.query: DevOps engineer dùng Kubernetes và Terraform

(exists (select 1 from job_skills js join skills s on s.id=js.skill_id where js.job_id=j.id and (s.canonical_name ilike 'Swift' or s.canonical_name ilike 'iOS' or s.canonical_name ilike 'iOS SDK' or s.canonical_name ilike 'iOS native' or s.canonical_name ilike 'lập trình IOS')) or (j.title ilike '%ios%'))

(exists (select 1 from job_skills js join skills s on s.id=js.skill_id where js.job_id=j.id and (s.canonical_name ilike 'Kotlin' or s.canonical_name ilike 'Android' or s.canonical_name ilike 'Android SDK' or s.canonical_name ilike 'Android Studio')) or (j.title ilike '%android%'))

retrieval.query: Tester kiểm thử tự động automation test Selenium
retrieval.relevance_rule: (exists (select 1 from job_skills js join skills s on s.id=js.skill_id where js.job_id=j.id and (s.canonical_name ilike 'Selenium' or s.canonical_name ilike 'Automation Testing' or s.canonical_name ilike 'Kinh nghiệm automation test')) or (j.title ilike '%tester%' or j.title ilike '%test%' or j.title ilike '%QA%' or j.title ilike '%QC%' or j.title ilike '%kiểm thử%')) and j.title not ilike '%pentest%' and j.title not ilike '%xâm nhập%'

retrieval.query: Kỹ sư NLP / LLM xây chatbot
retrieval.relevance_rule: (exists (select 1 from job_skills js join skills s on s.id=js.skill_id where js.job_id=j.id and (s.canonical_name ilike 'Natural Language Processing' or s.canonical_name ilike 'Large Language Models' or s.canonical_name ilike 'LangChain' or s.canonical_name ilike 'Xử lý ngôn ngữ tự nhiên (NLP)' or s.canonical_name ilike 'commercial LLM APIs%' or s.canonical_name ilike 'CoreNLP')) or (j.title ilike '%NLP%' or j.title ilike '%LLM%' or j.title ilike '%chatbot%' or j.title ilike '%generative%' or j.title ilike '%GenAI%'))
